exposure: umbilical vein blood flow (UVBF/AC) (normal vs. abnormal)
cohort: The study included 60 singleton fetuses with late fetal growth restriction (FGR) and abnormal placental cerebral ratio (PCR), subdivided into those with normal (>=fifth centile) and abnormal (<fifth centile) umbilical vein blood flow corrected for AC (UVBF/AC).
finding: Late-onset FGR fetuses with reduced umbilical vein flow showed significantly shorter corpus callosum and cerebellar vermis lengths and delayed cortical development (shorter SF, POF, and CF depths) compared to those with normal umbilical vein hemodynamics.
